dialogue.origin: おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になったら始めていきます。
dialogue.content: Good morning. Thank you for being here today. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.origin: おはようございます。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Good morning. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 相談者や内容などの設定のご希望はありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any preferences for the client's profile or the consultation topic?

dialogue.origin: 特にありません。フリーでお願いします。
dialogue.content: Not in particular. Please feel free to improvise.

dialogue.origin: 承知しました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。本日は相談にお越しくださりありがとうございます。ここでは安心してどんなことでもお話ください。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. Please feel safe to talk about anything here.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: I appreciate it.

dialogue.origin: はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: To begin, could you tell me your age, gender, and what you’d like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 55歳　女性　親について悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I’m a 55-year-old woman, and I’m struggling with issues regarding my parents.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。親についてのご相談ですね。もう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. So you're here to talk about your parents. Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.origin: はい両親と離れて暮らしていますが、介護問題が出てきまして、どうしたらいいのかと悩んでいます
dialogue.content: Yes. I live apart from my parents, and caregiving issues have come up, so I’m struggling with what to do.

dialogue.origin: 離れていての介護問題、悩んでしまいますよね。どうしたらいいのか、というのは具体的にどのような事でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Caregiving from a distance can be very challenging. When you say you’re unsure what to do, what specifically do you have in mind?

dialogue.origin: 母が多分認知症だと思うのですが、今は老老介護状態で、気になりながらも私が行けるのは月に1回程度しかなく、この先どうして行けばいいのか、今後を考えると不安しかありません
dialogue.content: I think my mother probably has dementia, and right now my elderly father is caring for her. I'm concerned, but I can only visit about once a month. I don't know what we're going to do from here on out, and I'm just filled with anxiety when I think about the future.

dialogue.origin: 母親がおそらく認知症、そして老老介護の状態。気にはなりながらもあなた自身の生活もあると思うのでお辛い状況かと思います。
dialogue.content: So your mother likely has dementia, and your elderly father is her caregiver. I can imagine this is a difficult situation for you, being concerned while also having your own life to manage.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 今の状況や環境はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me about your current situation and circumstances?

dialogue.origin: 私のですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean mine?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 家庭を持たれていたり、お仕事などありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have a family of your own or work commitments?

dialogue.origin: はい。夫と子ども2人のうち1人は既に家を出ています。仕事は週5で働いています。
dialogue.content: Yes. I have a husband and two children, one of whom has already moved out. I work five days a week.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。家庭のこと、お仕事もしながら親のことまで、、頑張ってこられたのですね。親の介護問題はいつからですか？
dialogue.content: I see. You've been managing so much—your family, your job, and on top of that, your parents' situation. You've really been working hard. How long has this issue with your parents' care been going on?

dialogue.origin: 3年くらい前からです
dialogue.content: For about three years.

dialogue.origin: 3年前から。たくさん大変なこともあったと思います。3年間本当に頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.content: For three years. I'm sure there have been many challenges during that time. You've really been doing your best for these three years.

dialogue.origin: この3年間はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How have these past three years been for you?

dialogue.origin: 最初は加齢によって起きていることだから仕方ないと思う様な感じでした
dialogue.content: At first, I felt like it was just a part of aging, so there was nothing to be done.

dialogue.origin: この1年でだんだん大変になってきた感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like things have gotten progressively more difficult over the past year.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。最初は年齢的なものもあり、仕方ないと思っていたのですね。この1年で親の状況が目に見えて変化があったということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So at first, you thought it was just due to age and unavoidable. Does this mean you've seen a noticeable change in your parents' situation over the last year?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。変化してきました
dialogue.content: Yes. There have been changes.

dialogue.origin: 変化していく中でどのようなことを感じましたか？
dialogue.content: What kind of feelings did you experience as you saw these changes?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…驚きと戸惑いですかね…
dialogue.content: Let's see... I guess surprise and confusion...

dialogue.origin: 驚きと戸惑いがあったのですね。介護問題といざ直面してみると、という感じですかね？
dialogue.content: So you felt surprise and confusion. Was it a sense of 'so this is what it's like to actually face caregiving issues'?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 親の老いや衰えをいざ目の当たりににすると驚いたり、戸惑ったりしてしまうのも自然なことだと思います。
dialogue.content: It's natural to feel surprised or confused when you're suddenly confronted with your parents' aging and decline.

dialogue.origin: ご兄弟やヘルパー等、介護の協力者はいるのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any help with caregiving, like siblings or a home helper?

dialogue.origin: 覚悟はしていたのですが、直面するとどうしていけばいいのか
dialogue.content: I thought I was prepared for it, but now that I'm facing it, I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 兄がいます
dialogue.content: I have an older brother.

dialogue.origin: あまり協力は期待できません
dialogue.content: I can't expect much help from him.

dialogue.origin: ヘルパーなどは特にいません
dialogue.content: We don't have a home helper or anything like that.

dialogue.origin: 覚悟はしていても直面してみると色々な感情が出てきて戸惑ってしまうと思います。
dialogue.content: Even if you thought you were prepared, I can imagine that facing it brings up all sorts of emotions and leaves you feeling confused.

dialogue.origin: はい今は父がひとりで頑張っています
dialogue.content: Yes. Right now, my father is doing his best on his own.

dialogue.origin: 兄がいるけど頼れない、ヘルパーもいないのですね。今まではあなたとお父さんで相談や協力をしてきたのですね。
dialogue.content: So you have a brother but can't rely on him, and there's no home helper. It sounds like until now, it's been you and your father consulting and working together.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。私は時々しか行けないので、ほとんど父頼みです
dialogue.content: That's right. Since I can only visit occasionally, it mostly falls on my father.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。老老介護とおっしゃっていましたが、お父さんの状況はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: I see. You mentioned your elderly father is caring for your mother. How is your father doing?

dialogue.origin: 今のところ元気です
dialogue.content: He's doing well for now.

dialogue.origin: 今のお元気なのですね。それは安心できますね。母親がおそらく認知症で老老介護の状況、
dialogue.content: So he's doing well at the moment. That's a relief. So, with your mother likely having dementia and your father being her sole elderly caregiver...

dialogue.origin: 今後のことが不安とおっしゃていましたが、今日ここで一番お話になりたいこと、気になることは何になりますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you're anxious about the future. What is the main thing you'd like to talk about or are most concerned about today?

dialogue.origin: 今後どうしていけばいいのかについてご意見を伺いたいと思っています
dialogue.content: I'd like to hear your opinion on what to do going forward.

dialogue.origin: 私が実家に戻るのも、親を呼び寄せるのもむずかしく
dialogue.content: It's difficult for me to move back to my parents' home, and it's also difficult to have them move in with me.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。一緒考えていけたらと思います。そのような話もされているのですね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. I'd like to think about this together with you. It sounds like you've already discussed those possibilities.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなた自身は一緒に住むことが出来たら安心だと思うのですね。ただ現実的に難しということですか？
dialogue.content: So you feel you'd be more at ease if you could live together, but that's not realistically possible?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。近くに居れば何かあった時に直ぐに駆けつけたり
dialogue.content: That's right. If I lived nearby, I could rush over if something happened,

dialogue.origin: 日頃の手伝いも出来るのですが
dialogue.content: and I could also help with day-to-day things, but...

dialogue.origin: 今は殆ど何もしてあげられなくて…
dialogue.content: right now I can hardly do anything for them…

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、距離が近いことでできることもたくさんあると思います。
dialogue.content: I understand. I'm sure there are many things you could do if you were closer.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 生活のためには仕事は辞めれないし
dialogue.content: I can't quit my job for financial reasons,

dialogue.origin: そのようにお感じなのですね。でも私は今日この場に来て心配していたり、家庭や仕事がある中で親の所に行ったりたくさん頑張ってこられたと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: I understand that's how you feel. But I think you've been doing so much already—worrying about them, coming here today, and visiting them while managing your own family and job.

dialogue.origin: 親のことを大切に思う気持ちがとても伝わってきます。
dialogue.content: I can really feel how much you care about your parents.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちだけでは殆ど助けにもならないですけどね
dialogue.content: But just feeling that way doesn't really help them much, does it?

dialogue.origin: そのようにお感じなのですね、でも気持ちがあるとない、
dialogue.content: I understand you feel that way, but there's a world of difference between caring and not caring.

dialogue.origin: 月に1回程度親のところに行っているというのでお父さんもお母さんも安心感はあるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you visit about once a month. Don't you think that gives your father and mother a sense of reassurance?

dialogue.origin: 距離的に近ければと思うけど現実的に難しい、他に何かできそうなことはありますか？
dialogue.content: You wish you could be closer, but that's difficult realistically. Are there any other things you think you might be able to do?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。喜んでくれているとは思いますが、父も体力的にいつまで介護できるのか…
dialogue.content: Yes. I think they are happy when I visit, but I worry about how much longer my father will be physically able to provide care...

dialogue.origin: せめて経済面で協力できればとも思うのですが、お恥ずかしい話それもなかなか難しいくて。
dialogue.content: I wish I could at least help out financially, but it's embarrassing to say that's also quite difficult.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、お父さんの体力も心配になってきますよね。そうでしたか、経済面のことまで考えていらっしゃたのですね。出来る出来ない抜きにして、そこまで考えていらっしゃて本当に大切に思われているのですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, your father's physical stamina is certainly a concern. I see, so you've even been thinking about the financial aspect. Regardless of whether you can or can't, the fact that you're thinking that far ahead shows how much you truly care for them.

dialogue.origin: 今まで検討されたこともあるとは思いますが、
dialogue.content: I imagine you’ve already considered this, but

dialogue.origin: 介護認定はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: what about applying for long-term care certification?

dialogue.origin: それを今父と話し合っているところです
dialogue.content: That's what my father and I are discussing right now.

dialogue.origin: 次に私が行った時、受診する予定です
dialogue.content: We plan to have her see a doctor the next time I visit.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。何かその話し合いの中で不安に思っていることなどありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is there anything about that discussion that's making you anxious?

dialogue.origin: 母に受診の事をどう伝えればいいかは悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm worried about how to tell my mother about the doctor's appointment.

dialogue.origin: 普段は普通な感じなので
dialogue.content: Because most of the time, she seems perfectly normal.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。伝え方を悩まれているのですね。介護認定と伝えると拒否されそうですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me. So you're concerned about how to bring it up. Do you think she would refuse if you told her it's for care certification?

dialogue.origin: 認知症のための受診と言ったら拒否する心配もあります
dialogue.content: I'm also worried she would refuse if I said the appointment was for dementia.

dialogue.origin: 自分ではしっかりしていると思っています
dialogue.content: She thinks she's perfectly fine.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。普通の時もあれば認知症かなと感じる時もある。お母さん自身もあなた自身も大変な状況だと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. So there are times she seems normal, and other times you feel it might be dementia. That must be a difficult situation for both your mother and for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 認めたくなかったり受け入れたくなかったりすると思います。
dialogue.content: I imagine she may not want to acknowledge or accept it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I suppose so.

dialogue.origin: 受診出来るのか…
dialogue.content: I wonder if we'll even be able to get her to go to the doctor...

dialogue.origin: 介護問題とひとくくりにされていますが、介護受ける側もサポートする側もたくさん悩みがあると思います。今はとりあえず受診してもらうこと、ですかね？
dialogue.content: It's all broadly called 'caregiving issues,' but I think there are many worries for both the person receiving care and the person supporting them. For now, is the immediate goal just getting her to the appointment?

dialogue.origin: 世の中一般的な介護問題ということです。
dialogue.content: I mean, that's a common challenge with caregiving in general.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。やはりそこからですよね。テレビとかで認知症の話題になっても人ごとの様に話しているので(母が)どう説明して受信させるかが悩みです
dialogue.content: Yes. That's really the starting point, isn't it? Even when dementia comes up on TV, my mother talks about it as if it's someone else's problem, so I'm worried about how to explain it and get her to go to the appointment.

dialogue.origin: 受信じゃなく受診でした
dialogue.content: Sorry, I meant 'doctor's appointment'.

dialogue.origin: そのような状況なのですね。受診出来たとしても先生の前だと普通に出来て認定がおりないということも聞きます。なので周りからの話も重要になってきます。
dialogue.content: I understand the situation. I have also heard that even if she does go to the doctor, she might act normally in front of them, and then she won't get certified. That's why what the people around her say becomes very important.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね…
dialogue.content: Is that so...

dialogue.origin: 母の前で話すのも気が引けます。
dialogue.content: I feel hesitant to talk about it in front of my mother.

dialogue.origin: 伝える側も心の準備が必要でしんどい役目だと思います。今日は間も無くお時間ととなってしまいます。受診する際のお母さんへの伝え方までお話が出来ていないのでまたこの続きから次回お話が出来たらと思いますがいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: It's a difficult role that requires mental preparation on your part as well. Our time is almost up for today. We haven't had a chance to fully discuss how to talk to your mother about the appointment, so I was thinking we could continue from this point next time. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。相談に乗っていただけると思うだけで少し気持ちが楽になります。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. Just knowing I can consult with you makes me feel a bit lighter.

dialogue.origin: 相談して良かったです。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm glad I came to talk to you. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: また宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.origin: 親のことを大切に思うからこそあなた自身が悩みすぎて共倒れしてしまわないかとても心配です。今日は勇気を出してここにお話に来てくれたことをとても嬉しく思います。
dialogue.content: It's because you care so much about your parents that I'm very concerned you might get overwhelmed by worry and burn out. I'm so glad you found the courage to come and talk about it here today.

dialogue.origin: 私の事まで心配していただきありがとうございます😭
dialogue.content: Thank you for being concerned about me, too. 😭

dialogue.origin: また是非相談させてください。
dialogue.content: I would definitely like to talk with you again.

dialogue.origin: あなた自身が一人で抱え込まずにまた一緒に考えていけたらと思います。いつでもお気軽にお話に来て下さいね。
dialogue.content: I hope we can continue to think about this together so you don't have to carry it all by yourself. Please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: それでは今日はここで終了メッセージを送らせていただいても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Alright then, is it okay if I send the closing message for today's session?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: That’s fine.

dialogue.origin: お願い致します。
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。またのご相談お待ちしております。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. I look forward to your next consultation.

topic.sub: 親の介護とその負担問題
